Atlanta Hawks — injuries
Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Indiana.
Landale injured his hip in Saturday's 121-99 loss to the Pelicans, and he'll now miss his first contest of the season. Asa Newell played a season-high 19 minutes with Landale out, and the former should continue to see his playing time increase behind Onyeka Okongwu for as long as that remains the case.
